about_the_game:
Nathan had always been the guy that girls overlooked - he tried, he tried, but it all ended with awkward pauses and a polite “I'll text you.” And then Aunt Chloe arrived - bright, confident, knowing all the answers. She took one look at him, grinned and said: “I'll have to save you.” And the lessons began - voice, looks, movements, gestures, the delicate balance of attention and detachment. But the most important lesson Chloe left for last - she decided to teach him what was really important in a relationship. She began teaching Nathan how to have sex the right way.

Key Features:

Deep Narrative: Dive into an intriguing story full of unexpected twists and secrets.
Quality Animation: Enjoy detailed and high quality sex animations.
Cool soundtrack: Discover the atmosphere of the game with an emotionally rich soundtrack.
